links.outcome: Localization accuracy of MLLMs versus task-specific CNN and radiologist benchmark
links.effect: GPT-5 49.7%, GPT-4 39.1%, MedGemma 17.7%, all lower than task-specific CNN (59.9%) and radiologist benchmark (80.1%).
links.quote: Averaged across nine pathologies in the CheXlocalize dataset, GPT-5 exhibited a localization accuracy of 49.7%, followed by GPT-4 (39.1%) and MedGemma (17.7%), all lower than a task-specific CNN baseline (59.9%) and a radiologist benchmark (80.1%).

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting to improve domain-specific MLLM localization performance
Spatial grid overlay prompting pipeline for coordinate-based localization
Integrating MLLMs with task-specific tools for reliable use

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark performance of multimodal large language models (GPT-4, GPT-5, MedGemma) on pathology localization in chest radiographs using the CheXlocalize dataset without testing a clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
